summary: A recurring drumming-guided shamanic journey circle at The Well in Asheville, facilitated by Randi Janelle, held on the second and fourth Wednesdays of every month per The Well's site. It's framed as an ongoing practice community ('grows our incredible, supportive community') rather than a one-off class, though it is drop-in/open to newcomers each time.

evidence.note: Both listing units use identical 'join our community & practice' language and repeat across years (2023, 2025, 2026, 2027), suggesting an ongoing standing offering, not a one-off.
Our DB only captured 2-3 sparse listings per unit over years despite the actual cadence being twice-monthly per The Well's own calendar, so scrape sparsity understates how established this is.

The Well's own event page: held 2nd and 4th Wednesdays monthly, facilitated by Randi Janelle, describes the goal of sharing/listening in circle as growing 'our incredible, supportive community', with snacks/fellowship afterward.

Web search snippets confirm the same recurring cadence, location (3 Louisiana Ave), price ($20-30), and describe it as Core Shamanism practice via sound/drumming welcoming both beginners and 'advancing practitioners' (implying returning regulars).

Single facilitator (Randi Janelle) runs it at a single venue (The Well) consistently across all 5 listings, which is typical of a practice community anchored to one teacher/space rather than a touring commercial class.
